notes.title: House of Pain joins Steam Scream: The Revenge Event – Wishlist and Stay Tuned!
notes.content: Prepare for a chilling experience as [b]House of Pain[/b] becomes a part of the electrifying [b]Steam Scream: The Revenge[/b] event. Don't miss out on this haunting adventure. Add [b]House of Pain[/b] to your Steam wishlist and keep an eye out for updates. Get ready to face your fears!
